main_text.p: bin,ut & nobis, verbum præteriti tem- poris.
Innethzon, Viscera, Sax. innope, nobis intward.

Innerontbingon, Inferioribus] Forte Interioribus, Sax. inpan(alias innepan) Bingum, nobis hodie inner things. Inferior autem Sax. nÿþep, nobis hodie nether, & neder: similiter Teutonicis, dialecto paululum variatâ.
main_text.head: Verba.
main_text.p: Irqnitke, Excita. Irqnitken sal tu, Vivificabis] Vide Gegnitco.
Irfcal, Increpuit] Ira, Sax. ÿppe; Irasci, ÿpriian?
main_text.head: L
main_text.p: Lap, Oram veftis] Hoc nobis hodie lap, à Sax. læp, sic dictum forte à Lat.

page.notes: Scan is a page of a 16th–17th century glossary; the left and right margins carry no clear notes. Several Old English/Saxon words are uncertain and may contain misreadings (e.g. "Irruozt", "Irqnitke"). Marginal numerals "35" in the right margin appear to be handwriting and were omitted.
